svg.title: An energy function proves which starts return to upright
svg.desc: The arm released from 0.1 radians starts inside the chosen region V of at most 0.1 joules and stays inside; released from 0.2 radians it starts outside, with V 0.2402 joules, enters that region after 0.46 seconds, stays inside and also returns. The largest torque, 3.20 newton metres, stays below the region's 5.2 newton-metre bound.
svg.text: An energy function proves which starts return to upright
Control Studio recordings of this project · arm held at 0.1 rad and 0.2 rad, then released to PD control · numbers answer the predictions
At rest: V = 0.2402 J outside (0.1 rad: 0.0600 J inside)
0.2 rad enters the 0.1 J region 0.46 s after the release
Largest torque 3.20 N·m (0.1 rad: 1.60), below the 5.2 N·m bound
